text: Absolutely, I recommend staging the interactive sound exhibit at the museum! Firstly, it is backed by robust safety measures with design elements that enforce strict hearing-safe volume limits certified by an audiologist. Secondly, creating a visitor-composed soundscape gallery would indeed establish a national milestone, showcasing innovative participatory experiences in auditory art. Moreover, having secured funding from a confirmed sponsor for both installation and the initial season not only bolsters confidence but also guarantees success. Lastly, we can draw on the success of similar audio installations elsewhere; a case study shows that a comparable light exhibit saw double the number of visitors over the same period, indicating high potential audience engagement. Combining these factors, it seems prudent to proceed with this exciting initiative.
